response.sql:
WITH pattern_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    `ANA Pattern`,
    AVG(`aCL IgG`) as pattern_avg_acl_igg
  FROM Examination
  WHERE `aCL IgG` IS NOT NULL AND `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`
),
cross_pattern_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(pattern_avg_acl_igg) as overall_avg
  FROM pattern_averages
),
above_average_patterns AS (
  SELECT pa.`ANA Pattern`, pa.pattern_avg_acl_igg
  FROM pattern_averages pa
  CROSS JOIN cross_pattern_average cpa
  WHERE pa.pattern_avg_acl_igg > cpa.overall_avg
),
above_average_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(pattern_avg_acl_igg) as above_avg_mean
  FROM above_average_patterns
)
SELECT 
  aap.`ANA Pattern`,
  aap.pattern_avg_acl_igg,
  aap.pattern_avg_acl_igg - cpa.overall_avg as above_cross_pattern_avg,
  aap.pattern_avg_acl_igg - aam.above_avg_mean as from_above_average_mean
FROM above_average_patterns aap
CROSS JOIN cross_pattern_average cpa
CROSS JOIN above_average_mean aam
ORDER BY aap.`ANA Pattern`;

assumptions.assumption: NULL `ANA Pattern` values are excluded from the analysis
The 'cross-pattern average' is a simple arithmetic mean of all per-pattern averages (not weighted by sample size)
